name: Mental Health
overview: Scripture addresses mental health by portraying God as the faithful Shepherd who provides for our needs and a refuge where we can find safety and peace amid life's challenges. Passages like Psalms 23:1 and Psalms 91:1 emphasize God's protective presence, while Isaiah 41:10 assures believers of divine strength and help in times of fear and distress. Jesus invites those burdened by anxiety and weariness to come to Him for rest (Matthew 11:28) and encourages trusting God daily without anxious worry about the future (Matthew 6:34). These verses collectively reveal a God who deeply cares for our mental and emotional well-being, offering comfort, rest, and sustaining strength through all trials.
